description: Taxonomy of engineering query intents and query states supporting SIH Problem Statement capabilities.

domain_intents.description: User queries directly for an explicit Indian Standard number or title (e.g., 'What is IS 1786?').
User describes a product, intended use, or raw material and requests governing BIS standards.
User asks for specific physical, chemical, electrical, or safety parameter limits in a standard.
User inquires about complementary test method standards, raw material codes, or normative references.
User inquires about the applicable conformity assessment scheme (Scheme-I, Scheme-II, Scheme-IV, etc.).
User asks how to obtain certification, application procedures, documentation, or factory audit steps.
User queries licence grant rules, marking fees, surveillance audits, or renewal timelines.
User asks for the specific Quality Control Order, issuing ministry, or gazette notification.
User asks whether certification is legally mandatory, voluntary, or under enforcement transition timeline.
User asks about mandatory factory tests, routine tests, or type test specifications.
User asks how a particular test is conducted, equipment used, or sample preparation.
User requests recognized BIS, regional, or partner laboratories for product testing.
User asks about precious metals hallmarking, purity standards, or jeweller registration.
User queries the 6-digit Hallmark Unique Identification system, laser marking, or verification.
User inquires about Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC) recognition and sampling rules.
User queries verification of ISI marks, CRS registrations, or reporting of counterfeit goods.
User asks how to use the BIS Care mobile app to verify licences and file consumer complaints.
Complex engineering, dimensional, or numerical tolerance questions across Indian Standards.
General institutional questions about BIS mandate, departments, or portals.

query_states.description: Query is well-scoped, within BIS domain, and has unambiguous intent matching normative records.
Query lacks sufficient specificity (e.g., 'What standard applies to steel/pipes?') requiring structured disambiguation.
Query regarding materials, products, or topics not governed by BIS (e.g., quantum computing, aerospace alloys, general trivia).
Query is within theoretical BIS scope but verified primary evidence is unavailable in the indexed registry.
Query asks for legal advice, judicial adjudication, or proprietary confidential manufacturer telemetry.
Query is submitted in Hindi or regional Indian languages requiring cross-lingual understanding before domain retrieval.
